title: 第19章 去救牛魔王第20章 把小白吓着了
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
傍晚，木屋前的院子里，篝火点燃了，烧烤摊又支起来了。
这次烤的是一只山羊，炭火烘烤下，羊肉的油脂滋滋作响，浓郁的肉香气息，极具诱惑。
落尘握着一只羊大腿，吃得满嘴流油。
小白却没有以往的胃口，吃了两口就停下了。
眼睛盯着院子的角落，脑袋乱晃，不停地示意落尘。
角落里，两只幻影狼的尸首还没来得及处理。
“小白，你要吃狼肉？”
落尘看懂了。
小白激动地点点头，眼神里都是期盼。
“狼肉又腥又柴有什么好吃的。
你愿意吃我给你烤些。”
落尘去砍了两只狼腿回来，架在火上开烤。
狼腿烤好，焦香混合着独特的膻味，这味道落尘不喜欢。
小白两眼放光，垂涎都流出来了，也不怕热，吃得狼吞虎咽。
两只狼腿下肚，意犹未尽。
“小白，你这么小身体，吃了两只狼腿，都吃哪去了？莫非你真是别人说的灵兽？”
落尘瞪大眼睛，仔细端详小白。
小白没点头也没摇头，眼睛又看向院子角落，示意还要吃。
“我就不信了，看看你到底能吃多少？”
落尘又走向院子角落。

最终，两只幻影狼都进了小白的肚子。
吃完最后一块肉，小白满意地打了一个饱嗝，缠绕在落尘胳膊上昏昏睡去。
“看样子，你真不简单呢，以后多给你抓妖兽吃，看看你能不能长大。”
落尘抚摸着小白，轻声念叨。
接下来的几天，落尘每天在灵溪谷内游山玩水，到处闲逛。
没再去管灵田的事。
木房又精心布置了一番，屋里的墙壁和棚顶加上了光滑的木板，房顶上铺上了树皮。
屋外面装上了一圈木篱笆，院子里搭了灶台。
俨然成了一个温馨的农家院。
闲暇时候，落尘总喜欢倚靠在院子里新编织的藤椅上，摇头晃脑地读陈广留下的几本书。
书中果然另有天地，几本书很普通，内容是天玄大陆的概况和修仙的简单介绍，这些修炼者几乎人尽皆知内容，却让落尘进入了一个新天地。
原来，天玄大陆分为五个大洲，除了核心部分的中州外，还有偏僻的东荒、西漠、南离、北冥四洲。
天玄大陆不知何其广大，仅仅落尘所在的东荒，方圆就有亿万里，难以穷极尽头。
大陆上生活着亿万万生灵，种族众多，人族、魔族、妖族是三大主要种族。
各族都有修行者，大能者可以一拳碎高山，一剑斩长河，飞天遁地，移山填海。
content_en:
In the evening, a bonfire was lit in the yard in front of the wooden house, and the barbecue stall was set up again.
This time, a goat was roasted. Under the charcoal fire, the fat of the lamb sizzled, and the rich meaty aroma was very tempting.
Luochen held a lamb thigh and his mouth was filled with oil.
Xiaobai didn't have the same appetite as before and stopped after taking two bites.
His eyes were fixed on the corner of the yard, his head was shaking, and he kept gesticulating to Luochen.
In the corner, the corpses of two phantom wolves had not yet been disposed of.
"Xiao Bai, do you want to eat wolf meat?"
Luochen understood.
Xiaobai nodded excitedly, his eyes filled with anticipation.
“What’s so delicious about wolf meat that’s fishy and woody?
If you want to eat, I'll bake some for you. "
Luochen went to chop off two wolf legs and came back, putting them on the fire and roasting them.
The wolf legs are roasted, and the burnt aroma is mixed with a unique smell of mutton, which Luochen doesn't like.
Xiaobai's eyes shone and his mouth watered. He was not afraid of the heat and devoured the food.
The two wolves' legs were lowered to their belly, and their thoughts were still unfinished.
"Xiao Bai, you have such a small body and you ate two wolf legs. Where did they go? Are you really the spiritual beast that others said?"
Luochen's eyes widened and he looked at Xiaobai carefully.
Xiaobai didn't nod or shake his head, and looked towards the corner of the yard, indicating that he wanted to eat more.
"I don't believe it. Let's see how much you can eat?"
Luochen walked towards the corner of the yard again.
In the end, both phantom wolves entered Xiao Bai's belly.
After eating the last piece of meat, Xiaobai burped with satisfaction, wrapped himself around Luochen's arm and fell asleep.
"It seems that you are really not easy. I will catch more monsters for you to eat in the future to see if you can grow up."
Luochen caressed Xiaobai and whispered softly.
In the next few days, Luochen visited the mountains and rivers in Lingxi Valley every day and wandered around.
He didn't care about Lingtian anymore.
The wooden house was carefully decorated, with smooth wooden boards on the walls and roof, and bark on the roof.
A wooden fence was installed outside the house, and a stove was set up in the yard.
It has become a warm farmhouse.
In his free time, Luochen always likes to lean on the newly woven wicker chair in the yard, shaking his head and reading a few books left by Chen Guang.
As expected, there is another world in the book. Some of the books are very ordinary. The content is an overview of Tianxuan Continent and a brief introduction to cultivating immortals. Almost everyone among these cultivators knows the content, but it allows Luochen to enter a new world.
It turns out that the Tianxuan Continent is divided into five continents. In addition to the core Zhongzhou, there are also the remote Donghuang, West Desert, Nanli, and Beiming continents.
The Tianxuan Continent is incredibly vast. The Eastern Wasteland where Luochen is located is hundreds of millions of miles in radius, and it's hard to end.
There are hundreds of millions of creatures living on the continent, and there are many races. Human race, demon race, and demon race are the three main races.
There are practitioners from all ethnic groups. The powerful ones can break mountains with one punch, cut rivers with one sword, fly into the sky and escape from the earth, move mountains and fill the sea.
